name: piano
description: Run Piano/Tuna workflows from Claude Code: a piano_run tool that returns a summary and output, with live progress in the transcript.

PIANO_CLAUDE_NATIVE.title: Register the native piano_run tool
PIANO_CLAUDE_NATIVE.description: Set to 1 to register mcp__piano__piano_run. Leave unset when the Piano MCP server is installed, so only one piano surface exists.

PIANO_PIANO_BIN.title: Piano binary
PIANO_PIANO_BIN.description: Path to the piano CLI. Empty uses `piano` from PATH.
